gloss: chairman (of a state or party); head of state

definitions.gloss: chairman; president (of a state or party)
definitions.explanation: The title of the head of state or ruling party in some countries, above all the President of the People's Republic of China ({国家|こっか}{主席|しゅせき}).

examples.japanese: ⟦{中国|ちゅうごく}→中国：28300_chuugoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{国家|こっか}→国家：02760_kokka⟧{主席|しゅせき}。
{主席|しゅせき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来日|らいにち}→来日：13060_rainichi⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。

⟦{首脳|しゅのう}{会談|かいだん}→首脳会談：31837_shunoukaidan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{首相|しゅしょう}→首相：03217_shushou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{主席|しゅせき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦{協力|きょうりょく}→協力：00261_kyouryoku⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{交|か}わした→交わす：19373_kawasu⟧。
examples.english: At the summit, the prime minister and the president exchanged views on economic cooperation.

notes:
USAGE:
In Japanese news the word appears almost only for China: the leader's full name + ⟦{国家|こっか}→国家：02760_kokka⟧{主席|しゅせき}, or the surname + {主席|しゅせき}. Historically it was also used for {毛沢東|もうたくとう} ({毛|もう}{主席|しゅせき}, Chairman Mao) and for the head of the Ryukyu government under US administration ({琉球|りゅうきゅう}⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧{主席|しゅせき}).

WATCH OUT:
⟦{首席|しゅせき}→首席：22104_shuseki⟧ (same reading) means "top place; chief": ⟦{首席|しゅせき}→首席：22104_shuseki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to graduate at the top of the class), ⟦{首席|しゅせき}→首席：22104_shuseki⟧⟦{奏者|そうしゃ}→奏者：06964_sousha⟧ (principal player). A head of state is {主席|しゅせき}; first place is ⟦{首席|しゅせき}→首席：22104_shuseki⟧.
